title: Public Soda Firings
bring: bisqued cone 6 pots with wadding applied
pay_text: $45 per 1/2 cf of space; up to two allotments (1 cf) per firing
how_to_join: Public firings announced on the studio's newsletter; sign up on the website when space is available
summary: Indigo Fire offers cone 6 soda firings open to the public throughout the year. Each registration costs $45 and includes half a cubic foot of kiln space; you can purchase up to two allotments. Bring bisqued cone 6 pots with wadding applied. Announced via newsletter.
source_quote: We host cone 6 soda firings that are open to the public throughout the year. Public firings are announced on our newsletter.
evidence_sentence: Public soda firings at the Moxie kiln are announced on the studio newsletter, with registration available when space remains.
evidence_quote: We host cone 6 soda firings that are open to the public throughout the year. Public firings are announced on our newsletter. If there's an upcoming public soda firing and space left, you can sign up here
